_comment: Di Russo et al. 2023 JNE 20 066006 - EXACT replication draft (first pass by ZCode 2026-09-21; Ben edits). Sources: extracted full text (spinal/_dirusso_2023.pdf), LIT_CIRCUIT_AUDIT.md section 10. Gains marked null are optimized by their CMA-ES - our optimizer searches them.

musculoskeletal_model.foot_contact: 3 spheres/leg: calcaneus r=0.05 m; two r=0.025 m at the MTP line
musculoskeletal_model.note: our Gait2392 conversion shares the Delp skeleton lineage (1.8 m, 75.16 kg, Thelen muscles); MTP contact split is the one delta. NEUROMECHANICAL MODEL: controller + musculoskeletal side are coupled - their results emerge from CMA-ES optimizing controller params against THIS musculoskeletal model with effort/stability objectives, so replication includes the coupled optimization, not a bolt-on
deltas_from_ours: MTP contact split (ours: one toes region)
their muscle list is 9/leg (ours is the full 92 - map or restrict)

cpg.equations: phi_dot_L = omega - gamma*sin(phi_L - phi_R - pi); phi_dot_R likewise
cpg.phase_reset: phi_side = 0 when that leg touches ground (heel strike)

pattern.weights_w_m_k: null = optimized, signed [-1,1], one row per muscle, one col per primitive

Ib.reversal: Ib -> excitatory IN -> SAME EXTENSOR MN (positive force feedback; extensor-classified muscles only; biarticulars may be both)

renshaw.targets: RC inhibits own MN and own IaIN

reflex_rules.cutaneous_rf: foot contact force input (drives rf receptor)

neuron_model: leaky integrator tau=0.01 s; MN activation f=min(max(0,x),1); SN rectifier max(0,x)
balance: Ong 2019 PD trunk controller on ILPSO/GMAX/HAMS during stance (kept as-is in their paper; state machine retained ONLY there)
